summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 29 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: From LLMs to hallucinations, here’s a simple guide to common AI terms
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical Marimo pre-auth RCE flaw now under active exploitation
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours
